complete_examples.text: Track–substructure local coordinates are defined to assist the confirming of the overlapped portions between the train–track system and the substructural system to effec-tively combine the cyclic calculation and iterative solution procedures.

Here a computational method for achieving TTS interaction is elaborated, which mainly includes the time-domain direct integration method, cyclic calculation method and iterative procedures for TTS interaction.
The cyclic calculation boundary is the foundation for achieving long-distance analysis and improving computational efficiency.
Compared with the cyclic calculation method used in Refs. [38,49], the methods used in this paper has conducted some optimization.
